item.title: [ 47] Trump files emergency motion to block BBC from getting financial details about business empire
item.description:
https://thehill.com/homenews/administration/6012228-bbc-financial-records-trump/

President Trump’s attorney filed an emergency motion Wednesday seeking to block the BBC from obtaining financial records linked to his trust.

The British broadcaster received approval from a judge late last month to probe the president’s financial documents after Trump claimed he experienced losses due to an episode of the company’s “Panorama” series titled “Trump: A Second Chance?”

In the footage, the BBC strung together three separate portions of a speech from Trump to make it look as if he encouraged a violent attack on the Capitol.

“The BBC’s improperly broad subpoena demands the Trust’s confidential tax, ownership, and financial records for approximately 400 entities,” Trump’s attorney Alejandro Brito wrote in the legal filing.

“Once the Trust were to begin handing those records over to the BBC, that disclosure could not be undone, and the Trust’s pending objections could not restore what the BBC will already have seen,” Brito added.

If the emergency motion is not approved, the BBC would be granted insight on Trump’s crypto and stock profit, as well as business transactions from at least 400 entities and companies tied to his personal assets managed by family.

item.title: [ 53] Global internet ID verification was inevitable
item.description:
And I'm tired of pretending otherwise.

Guess what, people 100 years from now will look back at the honeymoon phase of the Internet (or what we call the "wild west" today) and our lemming panic over a necessary change to fix the psychological damage it caused. They'll think "why were these retards against a common sense fix to multiple problems?". Looking back at history people didn't initially need an ID or certificate to drive a car, fly a plane, operate machinery, build homes or even be a medical professional only 130 years ago. Nobody but the most delusional lolbergs unironically thinks people should be allowed to drive, fly or do heart operations without a license today and the same mouthbreathers are screaming bloody murder doomsday over this.

Likewise, kids need to be booted off the internet once and for all to return to a semblance of normalcy. I guarantee the furries, transgenders and every other degenerate loon will disappear in time soon as those freaks don't have spaces to gaslight and amplify each other's mental illness then expose it to easily manipulated kids. Ideally most retarded adults shouldn't have access to the internet either, society needs to go back to a pre-1993 world when only a very small handful of intellectuals had access to mass communication and it should be rebuilt in new code from the ground up to filter out artificial intelligence as much as possible. The ID laws are a good start but don't go hard enough at the root problem.

>Cbus Super Stadium will be the venue for a Thursday evening clash as the Gold Coast Titans host the North Queensland Cowboys. The Titans suffered a crushing 6-42 loss to the New Zealand Warriors at Cbus Super Stadium in Round 22, while, the Cowboys are in disarray following a record-shattering 12-82 loss to the Sydney Roosters. item.title: [131] Mamdani Does the Big Funny: Centrally Planned Grocery Stores
item.description:
> https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/aug/02/mamdani-grocery-store-plan-new-york

Carlos Collado, a Dominican immigrant who owns five independent grocery stores in the Bronx and Manhattan, has succeeded over the last three decades despite obstacles that he blames on local and state governance.

His stores have faced an increase in shoplifting, he said. The city has provided tax benefits to big corporations that opened grocery stores and took business away from his.

Now, he says, New York’s new mayor, Zohran Mamdani, will make it even harder for him and other grocery store and bodega owners to succeed because of his plan to open five city-owned grocers. The mayor announced additional details about the stores this week, which he said will offer produce, meat and seafood for 30% less than typical retail prices.

Existing businesses will not be able to compete, Collado and some others say. But there is also support for Mamdani’s venture, saying that the stores will bring much-need food options into areas of New York city sorely lacking in grocery shops and help with a crisis in soaring food prices that hits some of the city’s most vulnerable families the hardest.

Food costs in the United States have soared in recent years. In June, the average price of ground chuck beef was almost $7 a pound, an 83% increase over June 2016, according to the US Bureau of Labor Statistics. In the New York-New Jersey area, the consumer price index for food increased 33% from 2015 to 2024, according to the Federal Reserve Bank of St Louis.

Hi, I'm an Europoor in my mid 20s visiting family in DC in a few weeks. I'll see them for the weekend but everyone will be gone by Monday afternoon. I have a shit tonne of annual leave that I have to use and I've been spending it just watching TV shows the last few years. So I decided to not book a return ticket and explore.
My family said it's not a good idea since I have no car, no driving license and America is very autocentric. However, I have hope. Hope that a sliver of America exists outside of the Freeway. Are there any places I should visit? I can be here for max 2 weeks. I have maybe $5,000 to spend. I noticed you have trains that run overnight. I am happy to spend a few nights sleeping on the plane. I don't need much sleep.
Problem, I am a very good religious man. I am not interested in Miami nightlife, hookers, bars, clubs, concerts, hookup culture, etc. I want to have a fun trip. I want an American experience but like Phineas and Ferb so I want to try stuff like the tallest roller-coaster, hike in a national park, try hunting maybe, jetski, whatever is fun. I don't want to see buildings all day or have a tour guide. Washington DC will be enough. Maybe NYC or Boston because they have a lot to see but that's about it.
Either a North East trip or a trip that's all over North America. I also don't mind Mexico and Canada.
Help me plan this please. I have no friends.
